cases.sentence: Боже, спаси меня своим ___, оправдай меня своей силой.
cases.translation: God, save me by your word, vindicate me by your power.
cases.explain: Слово is the direct object after 'спаси', taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Боже, услышь ___ мою, внемли слова моих уст.
cases.translation: God, hear my prayer, listen to the words of my mouth.
cases.explain: Молитву is the direct object of the verb 'услышь' (hear), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Чужие восстали против меня, беспощадные ищут смерти моего ___, те, кто о Боге не думает.
cases.translation: Strangers have risen up against me, and violent men seek the death of my enemy.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the verb 'ищут' (seek) when expressing the object of a search or desire.

cases.sentence: Те, кто о Боге не думает, не призывают ___ в помощь.
cases.translation: Those who do not think of God do not call upon Him for help.
cases.explain: Бога is the direct object of the verb 'призывают' (call upon), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Но воистину Бог мне ___, владыка меня укрепляет.
cases.translation: But surely God is my helper; the Lord sustains me.
cases.explain: Помощник is the predicate nominative after 'быть' (to be), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он воздаст врагам моим за ___, погубит их ради своей верности.
cases.translation: He will repay my enemies for their evil and destroy them for their faithlessness.
cases.explain: Зло is the direct object of the verb 'воздаст' (repay), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я добровольно принесу тебе ___, я буду славить имя твое, Господь.
cases.translation: I will willingly offer you a sacrifice; I will praise your name, Lord.
cases.explain: Жертву is the direct object of the verb 'принесу' (offer), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Потому что оно прекрасно, буду славить твое ___, ведь ты уберег меня от всех бед.
cases.translation: Because it is beautiful, I will praise your word, for you have protected me from all harm.
cases.explain: Слово is the direct object of the verb 'славить' (praise), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Боже, спаси меня своим именем, оправдай меня своей силой.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask God to do?
options: Save him by His name and vindicate him by His power
Make him king over all lands
reading.correct: Save him by His name and vindicate him by His power
reading.explain: Боже, спаси меня своим именем, оправдай меня своей силой — God, save me by your name and vindicate me by your power.

reading.ru: Боже, услышь молитву мою, внемли слова моих уст.
reading.question: What is the psalmist asking God to do with his prayer?
options: Listen to his prayer and hear the words of his mouth
Forgive him if his prayer is wrong
reading.correct: Listen to his prayer and hear the words of his mouth
reading.explain: Боже, услышь молитву мою, внемли слова моих уст — God, hear my prayer, listen to the words of my mouth.

reading.ru: Чужие восстали против меня, беспощадные ищут жизни моей, те, кто о Боге не думает.
reading.question: Who is rising up against the psalmist?
options: Strangers and ruthless men who do not think of God
reading.correct: Strangers and ruthless men who do not think of God
reading.explain: Чужие восстали против меня, беспощадные ищут жизни моей, те, кто о Боге не думает — Strangers and ruthless men who do not think of God seek his life.

reading.ru: Но воистину Бог мне помощник, владыка меня укрепляет.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's confidence in the face of his enemies?
options: God is his helper and the Lord sustains him
His enemies will become his friends
He is stronger than all his enemies
He will defeat his enemies through warfare
reading.correct: God is his helper and the Lord sustains him
reading.explain: Но воистину Бог мне помощник, владыка меня укрепляет — But surely God is my helper; the Lord sustains me.

reading.ru: Он воздаст врагам моим за зло, погубит их ради своей верности.
reading.question: What will God do regarding the psalmist's enemies?
options: Repay them for their evil and destroy them because of His faithfulness
Pardon them and show them mercy
Make them allies of the psalmist
reading.correct: Repay them for their evil and destroy them because of His faithfulness
reading.explain: Он воздаст врагам моим за зло, погубит их ради своей верности — He will repay my enemies for their evil and destroy them in His faithfulness.

reading.ru: Я добровольно принесу тебе жертву, я буду славить имя твое, Господь, потому что оно прекрасно.
reading.question: What does the psalmist promise to do?
options: Willingly offer sacrifice and praise God's name because it is beautiful
Force others to worship with him
Become a priest in the temple
reading.correct: Willingly offer sacrifice and praise God's name because it is beautiful
reading.explain: Я добровольно принесу тебе жертву, я буду славить имя твое — I will willingly offer you a sacrifice and praise your name.
